3 tables.

## public.children

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Key | Comment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer auto-increment |  |  | PK |  |
| `parent_a` | char(2) | yes |  | FK → public.parents.code_a |  |
| `parent_b` | char(2) | yes |  | FK → public.parents.code_b |  |
| `parent_id` | integer |  |  | FK → public.parents.id |  |
| `sibling_id` | integer | yes |  | FK → public.children.id |  |

Indexes:

- `children_parent_id_key` (parent_id), unique

Foreign keys:

- `children_parent_codes_fkey`: (parent_a, parent_b) → public.parents (code_a, code_b), on update restrict, on delete set null
- `children_parent_id_fkey`: (parent_id) → public.parents (id), on update not reported, on delete cascade, deferrable, initially deferred
- `children_parent_id_fkey2`: (parent_id) → public.parents (id), on update not reported, on delete cascade
- `children_sibling_fkey`: (sibling_id) → public.children (id), on update not reported, on delete not reported
